input_recipe.external: all games in input JSON; triad identified by its existing name
input_recipe.boundary: explicit zero-resource quotient and degree-zero constant fixtures in source
input_recipe.random: 16 games; Random(seed); n=1..3, E=1..4, d=0..3; w=p/q, p=1..7, q in {1,2,3}; a[e,k]=m*Q**k/D, m=0..3, D in {1,2,3}; 1..3 distinct subset actions/player
input_recipe.marker: alpha=beta-(beta-1)/10000; delta=min_s max_(i,b)(C_i-alpha*C_i_after); K=floor((alpha-1)/delta)+1; K resource copies and private constant-1 markers

limitations: Finite exhaustive implementation checks on the recorded rational fixtures only; not a proof for arbitrary games or real parameters, and no uniform d/ln(d) conclusion. The private-marker strict-margin criterion is checked with a real all-state non-PNE fixture; the equality calculation alone makes no nonexistence claim.
